titleOptions: NASA Fixed a 1977 Computer 15 Billion Miles Away
How Engineers Repaired Voyager 1 Without Touching It
The Voyager 1 Fix That Took 22 Hours Per Command

scenes.title: Hook
scenes.visual: Black space, tiny Voyager 1 line drawing far away; distance counter rolls up to 15,000,000,000 miles; a red 'ERROR' blink on the probe.
scenes.text: Engineers repaired a computer fifteen billion miles from Earth.

scenes.title: Gibberish
scenes.visual: Blueprint data stream from the probe turns into scrambled random symbols; label 'Nov 2023'.
scenes.text: In November 2023, Voyager 1 started sending back gibberish.

scenes.title: The dead chip
scenes.visual: Cross-section of the 1977 flight computer: a grid of memory chips, one chip flashes red and goes dark; label 'Flight Data Subsystem'.
scenes.text: The culprit was one dead memory chip inside its 1977 flight computer.

scenes.title: What it held
scenes.visual: Zoom into the red chip: code blocks inside it labelled 'packs the data'.
scenes.text: That chip held part of the software that packages Voyager's data.

scenes.title: No repairs possible
scenes.visual: A wrench icon flies toward the probe and stops at a huge distance line; label 'interstellar space'.
scenes.text: And nobody can swap a chip in interstellar space.

scenes.title: Split the code
scenes.visual: Memory map grid: the code block splits into four pieces that slide into separate empty gaps; arrows re-link them.
scenes.text: So engineers split the code into pieces and hid them in free memory.

scenes.title: 22 hours per command
scenes.visual: A pulse travels from an Earth dish to Voyager along a long line; timer counts up to 22.5 hours.
scenes.text: Every command took about twenty two and a half hours to arrive.

scenes.title: It worked
scenes.visual: Gibberish symbols turn back into clean bars of data; green check; label 'April 20, 2024'.
scenes.text: On April 20, 2024, readable data finally came home.

scenes.title: Quiet again
scenes.visual: Data stream flatlines to a thin carrier line; label 'Nov 14, 2026: diagnosing'.
scenes.text: This month, Voyager 1 went quiet again, and engineers are still diagnosing it.

scenes.title: Loop
scenes.visual: Distance counter from the hook returns, now showing 'one light-day'; question mark pulses.
scenes.text: Can they fix a computer fifteen billion miles away twice?

endCard.title: Never stop debugging
endCard.cta: Follow for a new engineering story every week
